title: Drugs Rules 1945 Amended: High-Alcohol Formulations (>12% v/v) Moved to Schedule H1
summary: Restricts over-the-counter sale of high-alcohol tinctures to prescription-only Registered Medical Practitioners.

items: Licensing Mandate: Formulations containing >12% v/v ethyl alcohol in quantities >30 mL removed from Schedule K exemption.
Schedule H1 Shift: Moved to Schedule H1 under Drugs Rules 1945 requiring mandatory prescription and record-keeping.
